speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: Hi, happy Labor Day. Are you a person who likes to help others?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Happy Labor Day to you as well. Not particularly, I mean I wouldn't ignore an elderly person who fell down in front of me but I don't usually do charity or volunteer work.

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: Have you heard of the Save The Children foundation?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: I have not, what kind of foundation is that?

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: The organization solicits donations to provide food, shelter and clothing to help children in improvished countries.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Oh that sounds good. I bet the foundation takes a huge chunk of the donations though, most of the non-profit CEOs are making crazy money, which really bugs me.

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: I share your dislike for organizations taking most of the donations. Save the Children turns 98% of donations directly into helping the children.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Well that's wonderful to hear, glad to see some organizations are actually doing what they preach so much about.

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: Save the Children now helps over 150,000 children in poor countries saving many lives.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Do they have any specific countries or regions they focus on? Or is it just everywhere on the globe?

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: A good share of the help takes place on the African continent.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: That makes sense, I can't imagine the living conditions for some of those kids. I've seen pictures of the starving children from down there and it's pretty rough.

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: Very sad to see. Any chance you would consider donating 50% of what you will earn for completing this hit?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: I'm not sure I could donate that much, I use MTurk to pay bills but I may be able to donate a small portion.

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: I know any about would be greatly appreciated. Would 10% of your hit earnings be possible?

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: I guess I could do 10%, it is for the kids after all and the organization does make sure almost all the money goes to them.

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: Thank you for your donation. I know Save the Children will be very thankful. I am donating 100% of my hit earnings as this is just a means to keep my mind working. Thank you again, you are very kind.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: That's awesome, your doing the good work! I hope enough of us work on donate for it to make some meaningful difference to the children.

speaker: A1DUH3RLI00YQM
text: I will do the best I can, again, that you for your help.

speaker: ACP3L9X63GBRK
text: Glad to have the opportunity, it feels easier to donate money this way than to take cash out of my wallet and donate it, maybe because it\'s just electronic "cash" right now or something heh.
